title: HellForge
summary: Launches HellForge, the offline Helldivers 2, and manages its mods: starts and ends sessions, selects profiles, changes settings, and shows logs and lobbies. HellForge's setup, repair and account sync remain in HellForge.exe.
intro: HellForge is an offline Helldivers 2 with its own copy of the game. This window starts the game and manages mods through HellForge's command line.
synced: HellForge synchronised with the library ({0} changes)
synced_1: HellForge synchronised with the library (1 change)
not_found: No HellForge installation was found. An installation is a folder that contains hellforge-install.json; the HellForge installer suggests Documents\HellForge.
not_an_install: The selected folder does not contain hellforge-install.json and is not a HellForge installation.
not_ready: HellForge has not been set up. The first setup copies the game from Steam, verifies ownership and installs the network block (one Windows administrator prompt). This can only be done in HellForge.exe: run it once, then return here.
launcher_during_session: A session is running. During a session HellForge temporarily replaces three files of its game copy, so HellForge.exe opened now shows its setup page; do not choose Start setup. Open it after the session ends. Open it anyway?
open_hellforge_setup: Open HellForge to complete the setup
stop_now_ask: End the game immediately? The game saves its shader cache only when it closes normally.
stopping: Closing the game… (it is ended after 30 seconds if it has not closed)
play_no_bingus_ask: LUA mods are enabled, but Bingus Shared Loader is not. HellForge does not run LUA mods without it. Start the game anyway?
status_preparing: Preparing: compiling mods and verifying the game copy
status_preparing_tools: Preparing: the first mod build; HellForge is downloading its compiler (Zig), which can take a few minutes
status_awaiting_network_block_install: Waiting for the network block to be installed (confirm the Windows prompt)
status_awaiting_windows_firewall_consent: Waiting for the firewall rules (confirm the Windows prompt)
status_cleanup_failed: cleanup failed; review the logs before starting again
lobbies_need_session: The lobby list is provided by the session's local backend. Enable co-op and start a session to list every HellForge lobby here.
lobbies_game_filter: In-game Quick Play and SOS search only lobbies on the same planet and difficulty; this list shows all lobbies.
lobbies_starting: The session is starting; the lobby list appears once its backend is ready.
lobbies_error: The list could not be refreshed: {0}
lobbies_unavailable: No lobby list is available in this session: {0}
quick_join_tip: Sends a join request to the most suitable lobby: lobbies with a free slot and friends' lobbies first, then the lobby that requires the fewest mods.
invited: An invitation from {0} has been sent to the game. Accept it in the game to join.
lobby_gone: The lobby is no longer listed.
no_joinable: No lobby can be joined at present.
multiplayer_off: Co-op is disabled in this session. Enable it under Profile and settings, then start a new session.
verdict_trust: A mod requires your trust (MOD SYNC)
verdict_unknown: Required mods are determined on joining
fix_edited_stats: Lobbies with host-enforced stat changes are hidden. This can be changed on HellForge's Mods page.
needed: Installing these mods makes more lobbies joinable
needed_hint: Lobbies you cannot join require these mods to be installed manually; sorted by the number of lobbies.
open_page_ask:
Open the following address in the browser? It is taken from another player's mod list:

port_unknown: Not compared with HellForge's game version: no official game folder is set in Quick Deploy
port_left_out: Not deployed to HellForge (made for the official game): {0}
port_kept: Different in HellForge's game version and deployed unchanged; visuals or audio may be incorrect: {0}
port_reading: Comparing the library's mods with HellForge's game version…
target_not_found: No HellForge installation was found. Select it in the HellForge plugin's window.
build_tools: Downloading the compiler for code mods (Zig, first time only); this can take a few minutes
build_problem: Did not compile, left out of the next session: {0}
target_clash: {0}: HellForge already contains "{1}", which was not deployed by Quick Deploy. Remove it in HellForge to deploy the library's version.
managed: Deployed by Quick Deploy. Enable and order it in Quick Deploy's HellForge list.
manage_in_manager: Manage HellForge's mods in the Quick Deploy main window by selecting HellForge above the library. On deploy, each mod is converted for HellForge's game version.
manage_needs_newer: Mods from Quick Deploy's library are deployed to HellForge by a newer version of HD2 Mod Quick Deploy (later than 0.19.0), which adds HellForge as a deploy target above the library. This version manages the mods already in HellForge.
target_nothing_left: {0}: contains nothing for HellForge's game version (made for the official game only); not deployed
locked: A session is running. HellForge keeps the mods the session started with; they can be changed after it ends.
modlist_tip: Players in co-op need the same code. It is generated from the shared gameplay mods.
modlist_none: None (no shared gameplay mods are enabled)
no_bingus: LUA mods are enabled, but Bingus Shared Loader is not. HellForge runs LUA mods only through Bingus Shared Loader (not Boot Mod Loader or MDL3).
add_intro: The selected mods are placed in HellForge's mods folder: as hard links to the library's files on the same drive, as copies on another drive. The library's files are not modified.
add_none: All library mods are already in HellForge.
add_there_already: HellForge already contains "{0}", which was not added from the library. Remove it in HellForge first to use the library's version.
add_refused: The following mods were not added to HellForge:
refuse_not_a_mod: HellForge does not recognise this as a mod: it has no manifest.json with options, no patch files at its top level and no hellforge-mod.json.
refuse_same_id: HellForge already contains this mod as "{0}", which was not added from the library. Remove it in HellForge first.
refuse_no_library_folder: The library folder does not exist: {0}
group_gameplay_hint: All players in co-op need the same mods; they determine the modlist code.
group_per_player_hint: Each player uses their own: not part of the modlist code and not downloaded in co-op.
group_cosmetic_hint: Client-side only; not part of the modlist code.
all_only_me: Set all gameplay mods to this player only
all_only_me_hint: Every shared gameplay mod (except HellForge's own) is set to this player only, including mods added later. The modlist code then contains HellForge's own mods only, so players with different mods can join each other. Recommended for every member of a community.
all_only_me_ask:
Set every shared gameplay mod to this player only?

Players with different gameplay mods can then join each other, and each player's game runs with that player's own mods. Mods that affect all players (enemies, missions, host rules) then behave differently on each player's computer in co-op.

HellForge's own mods remain shared, as do mods that HellForge does not allow to be per-player; these are listed.
all_only_me_done: {0} gameplay mods set to this player only
all_only_me_done_1: 1 gameplay mod set to this player only
all_only_me_refused: HellForge requires it to remain shared: {0}
all_only_me_refused_tell: HellForge does not allow these mods to be per-player, because their changes must be identical on every computer. They remain shared:
only_me_tip: Treated as this player's own in co-op ("coop": "per-player"): not part of the modlist code and not downloaded by other players.
only_me_ask:
Set "{0}" to this player only?

Use this only for mods that each player also uses individually in the official game. A mod that changes gameplay for all players makes the players' games inconsistent in co-op when set this way.

The setting is written into HellForge's copy of the mod and is written again when the mod is updated.
move_up: Move up (loads later and takes precedence over the mod above)
remove_ask: Remove "{0}" from HellForge? Its files in the library are not affected.
profile_hint: Each profile has its own progress and inventory.
profile_name_rule: 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
war_hint: Frozen: the war state included with HellForge. Live: the current war, read-only. Every planet open: all planets are available.
strangers_hint: Lists the game in public lobbies and allows strangers to join. Data sent by their games is not validated.
strangers_ask:
Enable play with strangers?

HellForge is open source and has no anti-cheat; data sent by strangers' games is not validated. HellForge recommends enabling the sandbox as well.
sandbox_hint: The game runs at low integrity, with Steam through HellForge's Steam broker.
live_changes_hint: Takes effect when a session starts.
forge_credits_hint: The share of random loot caches that contain Forge Credits (HellForge default: 30 %). All players in a co-op mission should use the same value.
account_hint: Inventory sync from the live game is done in HellForge.exe; HellForge does not yet provide a command for it.
account_sync_how: HellForge will now open. Sync the account there (Sync Inventory).
proxy_on: The Windows system proxy is enabled, which causes HellForge's account sync to fail. Disable the system proxy in the proxy tool (such as Clash) before syncing.
proxy_ask: The Windows system proxy is enabled, which causes HellForge's account sync to fail. Disable it in the proxy tool (such as Clash) first.
languages_hint: HellForge's game copy always includes English.
language_steam: Download it in Steam first: paste the following into the Steam console (steam://open/console).
logs_hint: The ten most recent sessions are kept, plus the five most recent crashed sessions among older ones.
ended_error_hint: The game left a crash dump or an error code when it closed. On HellForge's game version this also occurs when the game is closed normally; the crash report provides details.
dump_ask: Include the full crash dump? It contains the game's memory and cannot be cleared of personal data; send it only to people you trust.
crash_report_done: The crash report was saved as {0}. Nothing was uploaded. To report the crash, attach the file to a new issue at {1}.
note_in_tip: This mod is in HellForge's mods folder.
note_stale_tip: The library's files have changed since the mod was added to HellForge; they are synchronised when the HellForge window opens.
risk_render_config: Replaces the render configuration made for the official game; on HellForge's game version the image may show incorrect colours. A HellForge version of the mod is required.
risk_strings: Replaces game text tables made for the official game; on HellForge's game version text may be incorrect or missing.
risk_bml: Its LUA calls Boot Mod Loader's own API; HellForge uses Bingus Shared Loader, so it cannot run.
